# OMKit

Loader flashed once; core and modules then run from the SD card.

[Contribution home](https://github.com/necrostaz/omkit/issues). Release v0.1.0 (2026-11-20) for the OM-5 Mark II on firmware 1.1. The developers report the loader patch running on their camera since 2026-10-30 and starting core on every full power-on. Wi-Fi and USB start paths are not verified, and the project calls itself young software.
